items.title: OpenAI acquires Pierre Computer Company to make Git keep up with AI coding agents
items.summary: OpenAI is buying Pierre Computer Company, the startup whose libraries already power the coding agent Codex. Combined with OpenAI's recently launched Git backend Pando, the deal shows the company is building out its infrastructure for developers and AI agents working side by side. items.title: New open-source benchmark reveals reasoning as the biggest bottleneck for AI in cloud operations
items.summary: CloudOpsBench is a new open-source benchmark that measures how well AI agents handle typical DevOps tasks in the cloud, from fixing services and removing resources to restricting access rights, rolling out updates, and decommissioning projects. The article New open-source benchmark reveals reasoning as the biggest bottleneck for AI in cloud operations appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights
items.summary: MIT researchers show that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can read and deliberately rewrite the weights of other AI models without traditional training. In one experiment, Astra boosted a Qwen model's math accuracy from 7.9 to 48.1 percent by changing just 0.016 percent of its weights. items.title: Anthropic's new prototype proves which model wrote an AI response without exposing its weights
items.summary: Anthropic has released FlashProve, a research prototype that uses cryptography to verify whether an AI response actually came from the claimed model. The system still has significant limitations. The article Anthropic's new prototype proves which model wrote an AI response without exposing its weights appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Exit polls show AI ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterms
items.summary: In the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, AI ranked last among campaign issues: only 56 percent of respondents cited AI and data centers as an important factor. According to NBC exit polls, corruption (90 percent) and the cost of living (89 percent) clearly dominated, despite growing public attention to the issue. The article Exit polls show AI ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterms appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027
items.summary: Starting in 2027, Google plans to turn off AI features in its school products by default, letting schools decide what to enable. The catch: schools that block AI entirely on their devices will also lose access to Google Search, since the two systems are now too deeply intertwined to separate. items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
items.summary: OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. items.title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
items.summary: Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest. The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
items.summary: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time. The article AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary, gaining bipartisan reach just as midterms loom
items.summary: OpenAI hires Dan Driscoll, the former civilian head of the US Army, as "Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization," likely to win government contracts and help shape AI rules for the military and intelligence agencies. Driscoll drove AI projects inside the Army, is a close ally of Vice President JD Vance, and yet maintains good relationships with both parties in Congress - which could prove valuable as midterms approach.
